name: Tomorrow's Marble
description: A four-machine Rube Goldberg contraption sends marbles across a timeline. Schedule arrivals, run the visible machine, and close every arrival/departure loop without a paradox.
natural_language: Schedule every highlighted marble arrival, run the physical contraption, and make both causal loops return each piece to its assigned past.

metadata.notes: Original self-contained time-loop ledger grounded in the supplied Chrontraption survey record. The browser renders the visible machine and timeline, while the server and exported verifier replay every scheduled transition independently.
